name: Ignarus
storyline:
Awoken by a mysterious black cat on a stormy night, Vi — an ordinary boy — is lured into the Under-Realm: a dying world on the brink of collapse.

Monsters once ruled the land, but something far darker now rises to claim it. As the realm’s final hours draw near, Vi must forge uneasy alliances to protect the last sparks of hope in a fading world…

Or watch it all collapse into ruin.
summary:
Ignarus is a Dark old school Action RPG with a story to tell.

There will be experience gained to level up and learn new abilities, as well as challenging monsters and boss battles to test your skills.

Some dungeons and puzzles will test your wits and solving skills and leave you satisfied.
